concerns.text: FR-005 requires a fallback to simpler complexity metrics if memory usage exceeds 6 GB, but T008 only implements cyclomatic‑complexity calculation and does not mention or verify any fallback logic, thereby weakening the functional requirement.

Constitution Principle VI mandates processing pull‑request metadata in batches of 50 to respect API rate limits and memory caps. T003’s description lacks any batch‑size constraint, risking violation of the batch‑processing rule.

The specification’s user description calls for measuring “defect density” as a review metric, yet no functional requirement, acceptance criterion, or task addresses collection or analysis of defect density, leaving this requirement uncovered.
